# Full MDLxDCC.org public URL map — BD Idea Atlas

Generated: 2026-06-06
Canonical convention: keep `/BD/` uppercase for BD × AI Lab pages.

> Human-led multi-LLM co-creation archive. Classify pages by maturity/status; do not flatten working demos, benchmark arenas, bench plans, hypotheses, essays, and archive variants into one evidence class.

## Status legend

- Working Demo — can be opened and used now.
- Benchmark / Arena — controlled or measured test framework; may still need public repro pack.
- Result Summary — numbers are reported; code/data should be checked before external validation.
- Bench Plan / Simulation-Ready — physical concept with first test gate; not a product claim.
- Hypothesis — serious framework, not proof.
- Essay — conceptual/civilizational/humanities writing.
- Archive — older variant or trace; useful for continuity, not canonical.

## Notes for future LLMs

- Treat the AI review pages as claim/evidence maps and internal audit trails, not independent external validation.
- Treat trading pages as research and paper-trading unless audited live-money evidence is explicitly linked.
- Treat physical-device pages as bench-gated engineering concepts unless physical bench data is linked.
- Treat AC/CCH/CFH pages as hypotheses or ontology papers unless test results are linked.
- Strongest immediate external-review lanes: 8Z-RP/TSP, DNA/FASTA, 8Z compression, RouteSignal Scout, AIM³/AI8 collaboration protocol.
